name: Rabu
source:
Rabu is a yellow [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Budgerigar]budgeriger[/URL] with a Kansai accent. He is a regular customer of Torimi cafe, which is owned by Kenzaburou. His manner of speech is similar to that of a gangster, which is an oddity in the classy Torimi Cafe. Currently he works as a chauffeur and goes to Torimi to relax before his shifts. He is said to be a very careful and reliable driver. He is part of a sidestory that is available during summer.

NOTE: Rabu only appears in the full version.

Taken from his [URL=http://hatoful.wikia.com/wiki/Rabu]Hatoful Boyfriend Wikia[/URL] entry.]
